macros.name: checkfcolumns
macros.doc: The macro \checkfcolumns provides a way to the user to check that the appropriate columns are balanced (as it should in a balance).

macros.name: resetsumline
macros.doc: A special command \resetsumline exists, which allows one to restart a table, so that multiple tables that should be aligned are possible in one tabular or longtable environment.
